attributes.name: type_of_garment
attributes.description: The type of clothing item, e.g., Dress, Top, Bottom, Outerwear, Accessories.

attributes.name: material
attributes.description: The primary material of the fabric, e.g., Cotton, Polyester, Silk. Extract from text if possible.

attributes.name: weave
attributes.description: The weave of the fabric, e.g., Twill, Satin, Poplin. Extract from text if available.

attributes.name: fiber_blend
attributes.description: The specific fiber composition, e.g., 80% Cotton / 20% Polyester. Extract from text if available.

attributes.name: primary_color_overall
attributes.description: The general category of the main color, e.g., Red, Blue, Green, Pink.

attributes.name: primary_color_specific
attributes.description: The specific shade of the main color, e.g., Lavender, Mauve, Crimson, Sage Green.

attributes.name: secondary_color_overall
attributes.description: The general category of the second most prominent color, if present.

attributes.name: secondary_color_specific
attributes.description: The specific shade of the secondary color, e.g., Gold, Silver, Mint Green.

attributes.name: pattern_or_print
attributes.description: The visual pattern on the fabric, e.g., Solid, Floral, Striped, Polka Dot, Abstract.

attributes.name: fit
attributes.description: The fit of the garment on the body, e.g., Slim Fit, Regular Fit, Oversized, Relaxed Fit.

attributes.name: aesthetic
attributes.description: The overall style or vibe of the item, e.g., Cute, Elegant, Corporate, Grunge, K-Pop, Modest.

attributes.name: occasion
attributes.description: Suitable occasions for wearing the item, e.g., Date Night, Office, Picnic, Wedding Guest, Casual.

attributes.name: neckline
attributes.description: The style of the garment's neckline, e.g., V-Neck, Crew Neck, Scoop Neck, Halter.

attributes.name: sleeve_length
attributes.description: The length of the sleeves, e.g., Sleeveless, Short Sleeve, Three-Quarter, Long Sleeve.

attributes.name: sleeve_style
attributes.description: The design of the sleeves, e.g., Puff, Bell, Raglan, Cap Sleeve.

attributes.name: silhouette
attributes.description: The overall shape or outline of the garment, e.g., A-Line, Sheath, Mermaid, Ball Gown.

attributes.name: waistband
attributes.description: The style of the waistband, e.g., Elastic, High-Waisted, Drawstring, Paperbag.

attributes.name: length
attributes.description: The overall length of the garment, e.g., Mini, Midi, Maxi, Cropped, Ankle-Length.

attributes.name: brand
attributes.description: The brand name of the product, if visible or known.
